# 
# Great Science
# Deep Compassion
# Real Impact

##### Leveraging our long-standing neuroscience
##### expertise to develop medicines that
##### make a difference.

[Discover Our Stories ][48]

### Featured News

**July 14, 2026**

Alkermes to Report Second Quarter Financial Results on July 28, 2026

[Read more][49]

**July 13, 2026**

Alkermes’ Alixorexton Demonstrated Sustained Improvement in Wakefulness in Adults With Narcolepsy
Type 1 and Type 2 in Long-Term Extension Study Int...

[Read more][50]

**June 17, 2026**

Alkermes Presents Detailed Positive Results From Vibrance-2 Phase 2 Study of Alixorexton in Adults
With Narcolepsy Type 2 at SLEEP 2026

[Read more][51]

[See all press releases][52]

[Smiling businessman at Alkermes.]

### Leadership in Sleep Medicine


Hear from our Chief Operating Officer Blair Jackson as he shares his perspective on Alkermes’
recently-completed acquisition of Avadel Pharmaceuticals plc.

[Read the article][53]

### Understanding Narcolepsy


Narcolepsy is a rare neurological disorder that is often misunderstood and stigmatized. Our team
members describe the physical symptoms that people living with this sleep disorder face, along with
the emotional and psychological impact, in a video created to foster understanding.



[Watch the video][54]

[Woman having a conversation with ork colleague.]

[Portrait of woman in green jackt in office setting.]

### Notable Recognition

We are honored to be recognized as an employer of choice in the life sciences industry. Visit our
Awards & Recognition page to see the latest accolades bestowed on Alkermes by leading news and
ranking organizations.

[Visit our Awards & Recognition page][55]

### R&D Pipeline 



##### We apply our deep neuroscience expertise to develop medicines designed to help people living
##### with complex and difficult-to-treat psychiatric and neurological disorders. We are currently
##### focused on developing these investigational candidates.

[Click to view our interactive pipeline][56]
* Discovery
* Preclinical
* Phase 1
* Phase 2
* Phase 3
* Sodium oxybate extended-release oral suspension
  * Idiopathic Hypersomnia
    
    Phase 3
  
  A once-nightly formulation of sodium oxybate for extended-release oral suspension is currently
  being evaluated for use in adults with idiopathic hypersomnia in a phase 3 study, REVITALYZ. For
  more information about this study, please visit **[clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06525077][57]**.
* Olanzapine and samidorphan
  * Schizophrenia and Bipolar I Disorder (Pediatric)
    
    Phase 3
  
  Olanzapine and samidorphan is currently being evaluated for pediatric use in a phase 3 study,
  ENLIGHTEN-Youth. For more information about this study, please visit
  **[enlightenyouthstudy.com][58]** (U.S. audiences only) or
  [**clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05303064**][59].
* Alixorexton
  * Narcolepsy Type 1
    
    Phase 3
  * Narcolepsy Type 2
    
    Phase 3
  * Idiopathic Hypersomnia
    
    Phase 2
  
  Alixorexton (formerly ALKS 2680) is an investigational, oral orexin 2 receptor agonist in
  development for the treatment of narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2 and idiopathic hypersomnia.
  
  Alixorexton is currently being evaluated in the phase 3 Brilliance Studies program in adults with
  narcolepsy type 1 and narcolepsy type 2, and in Vibrance-3, a phase 2 study in adults with
  idiopathic hypersomnia. Participants who complete one of the Vibrance or Brilliance studies have
  the option to continue in a long-term, open-label, safety study evaluating the safety of
  alixorexton for up to two years.
  
  For more information about enrolling studies, please visit **[brilliancestudies.com][60]**,

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]

  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

day and everywhere.

and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

### Fresenius Kabi recognized as a Top Employer in 13 countries

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]
[

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]
][113]
[

### Meet The Heroes Behind Patient Safety

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.
Discover how people make the difference.
[Several people in different job roles like production and lab workers depicted as heroes with capes
and gadgets.]
][114]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying

focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

Welcome to our team, where the vision of the Board, the leadership of the Management team and the
dedication of the operational staff come together. We are not just colleagues, we are the Adragos
family dedicated to making a difference in the CDMO industry.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Event Participation
* **CPHI Worldwide**
* **Arab Health**
* **IPHEX**
* **CPHI India**
Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and

reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## Welcome to Algen Healthcare Ltd

# **Best Pharma Franchise Company in India**

Algen Healthcare is one of the highly recongized ISO certified pharma company that offers best
quality pharmaceutical products for franchise business and third party manufacturing services. The
company work under the norms set by the (WHO) World Health Organisation and (GMP) Goods
Manufacturing Practice which enables us to match the global standard of the products and company.

Serving with the wide range of quality pharma products with DCGI and FSSAI approval makes us the
ideal platform to get effective medicines for some special ranges. Our all products are widely
preferred because our all products are manufactured in a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility
with the assistance of experts. We cover product segments like;-
* Antibiotics
* Anti-infective
* Pediatric
* Health Supplements
* Cardiology
* Diabetology
* Gynecology
* Dry Injectables
* Softgel
* Anti-Hiv

## Algen Healthcare Ltd Servicing In Last 21 Years

[Our Products][26]

### General Range

It is the specialty of medicine that deals with the prevention, diagnosis & treatment of various
acute & chronic conditions that affect various parts of the body.

[Read More ][27]

### Ointment cream

Ointments are preparations for external use, intended for application to the skin. Topically, they
have an oily or greasy consistency & can appear “stiff” as they are applied to the skin.

[Read More ][28]

### Powder

A pharmaceutical powder is defined as a dry, solid substance, composed of finely divided drugs with
or without excipients and intended for internal or external use.

[Read More ][29]

### Sachet

We at algen healthcare limited ever world class setup manufacturing facility for sachet we
manufacture around 100 + approval in different formulations in neutraceutical and pharmaceutical
with effervescent technology.

[Read More ][30]

### Cardio Diabetic

We at algen healthcare limited manufacture and market a wide range of cardio diabetic drugs in
sustained released form and in bi-layer technology with 100% bioavailability and efficacy

[Read More ][31]

### Paediatrics

Paediatrics is the specialty of medical science concerned with the physical, mental, and social
health of children from birth to young adulthood.

[Read More ][32]

### Syrup

We at Algen healthcare limited manufacture around 500 + formulations of syrup with excellent
efficacy 100% accuracy and delicious taste

[Read More ][33]

### Injectable

An Injectable is considered a form of parenteral drug administration; it does not involve absorption
in the digestive tract.

[Read More ][34]

### Softgel

A softgel is an oral dosage form for medicine in the form of a specialized capsule. They consist of
a gelatin based shell surrounding a liquid fill. Softgel shells are a combination of gelatin, water,
opacifier and a plasticiser such as glycerin or sorbitol.

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]
[AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK]

Gas prices get a lot of attention, but they’re driven by a complex set of global factors, with crude
oil markets playing the central role. This explainer puts those dynamics into context and breaks
down what’s behind the numbers at the pump.

Building new infrastructure allows energy to flow faster and more easily which could make energy
more affordable for consumers.

## Energy Economics

API conducts or sponsors analysis and research in support of free markets, inform cost-effective
regulation, and promote economic growth. API also collects, maintains, and publishes statistics on
all aspects of industry operations. Together, this analysis, research, and statistics provide facts,
context, and insights for policy makers, media, and the public.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

Learn why Boston Children’s employees and patients say they’re choosing to get vaccinated.

Share this:
[Dr. Shwachman uses the sweat test box he invented to diagnose cystic fibrosis]

### The history of cystic fibrosis diagnosis

In 1955, Dr. Harry Shwachman, head of Boston Children’s Cystic Fibrosis Clinic, developed the first
practical sweat test to diagnose cystic fibrosis (CF). It involved encasing the patient’s body in a
plastic bag to collect sweat, then using the pictured device to measure levels of salt in the
sample. Cystic fibrosis causes sweat to be 2-5 times saltier than average. The sweat test allowed
for much simpler and earlier diagnosis of CF, crucial to effective treatment. A version of it is
still the main diagnostic tool used today.

 

Learn more about [Boston Children’s Archives Program.][103]

Boston Children’s is proud to join the Broad Institute and The Jackson Laboratory to launch the
Center for Therapeutic Genetics (CTG) — a new collaboration advancing genetic medicines for rare
diseases.

Fewer than 1 in 20 rare diseases currently has an approved treatment. CTG is working to change that
by building scalable approaches to develop personalized therapies faster and expand access for more
patients and families.

Led by Boston Children’s Drs. Wendy Chung and Timothy Yu, alongside collaborators Dr. David Liu, Dr.
Cat Lutz, and Dr. Winston Yan, this effort brings together leaders in genetics to make
individualized medicine more efficient, accessible, and repeatable.

This is what the future of rare disease care can look like. ... [See MoreSee Less][59]

[Dr. Shwachman uses the sweat test box he invented to diagnose cystic fibrosis]

### The history of cystic fibrosis diagnosis

In 1955, Dr. Harry Shwachman, head of Boston Children’s Cystic Fibrosis Clinic, developed the first
practical sweat test to diagnose cystic fibrosis (CF). It involved encasing the patient’s body in a
plastic bag to collect sweat, then using the pictured device to measure levels of salt in the
sample. Cystic fibrosis causes sweat to be 2-5 times saltier than average. The sweat test allowed
for much simpler and earlier diagnosis of CF, crucial to effective treatment. A version of it is
still the main diagnostic tool used today.

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video
Play Video
09:22

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.

1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not overshadow this
| 06/1/26]

### ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK
### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

7/21/2026

into explainable recommendations designed to improve clinical development decisions.

[[Nina Bauer]][57]
7/16/2026

## Good instincts are nice.
## *Great data* are better.

People switch to DrugPatentWatch because they're tired of the high cost and low quality of their
analysts. You shouldn't have to wait for a report to understand your market.

Every drug is perpetually updatd from primary sources. The latest information is always available —
no delays, no filters, no spin.

Keytruda (pembrolizumab) 2028 High Value
Humira (adalimumab) Expired Generic
Eliquis (apixaban) 2026 Watch
Ozempic (semaglutide) 2032 Monitored
The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

subscription you might cancel.
🔄
Updated while you sleep
Every drug profile is refreshed from primary sources daily. No editorial lag. No publication

experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

Drugzone strengthens its nationwide supply reliability through long-standing partnerships with
leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable
pricing, and consistent access to essential medications across multiple therapeutic areas.

Direct sourcing from trusted and approved manufacturers ensures product integrity and verified

[img]

[img]

Every product undergoes multi-step verification and documentation to confirm authenticity before

[img]

At Drugzone, equal commitment is given to human and animal health, ensuring safe, compliant, and
reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025
standards.

[img]

## Human Health

Drugzone supports healthcare facilities nationwide with access to safe, cost-effective generic
formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

[img]

### Comprehensive Product Range

A broad portfolio of quality-assured generic pharmaceuticals designed to support hospitals, LTC
networks, and specialty care facilities.

[img]

Reliable distribution designed to help hospitals and specialty networks maintain consistent
treatment availability.

[img]

### Regulatory Compliance

Strict adherence to NABP and FDA guidelines, ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable delivery of
human health products.

[Know more][20]

## Animal Health

Drugzone extends its trusted distribution network to veterinary hospitals, clinics, and animal care
providers, ensuring consistent access to essential products.

[img]

### Veterinary Product Lines

Dedicated pharmaceutical solutions designed for veterinarians, clinics, and animal healthcare
facilities.

[img]

### Specialty Formulations

Sutures, oncology formulations, and generic alternatives tailored for animal health practices.

[img]

### Trusted Distribution

Compliant with all state and federal regulations to guarantee authentic, traceable supply for animal
care providers.

[Know more][21]
[img]

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## Licensed in All 50 States

With FDA registration and DSCSA 2025 readiness, our 50-state licensing ensures healthcare providers
across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.

We work with companies and manufacturers worldwide.

reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025
standards.

[img]

## Human Health

Drugzone supports healthcare facilities nationwide with access to safe, cost-effective generic
formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

[img]

### Comprehensive Product Range

A broad portfolio of quality-assured generic pharmaceuticals designed to support hospitals, LTC
networks, and specialty care facilities.

[img]

### Hospital& Specialty Pharmacy Support

Reliable distribution designed to help hospitals and specialty networks maintain consistent
treatment availability.

[img]

### Regulatory Compliance

Strict adherence to NABP and FDA guidelines, ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable delivery of
human health products.

[Know more][20]

## Animal Health

Drugzone extends its trusted distribution network to veterinary hospitals, clinics, and animal care
providers, ensuring consistent access to essential products.

[img]

### Veterinary Product Lines

Dedicated pharmaceutical solutions designed for veterinarians, clinics, and animal healthcare
facilities.

[img]

### Specialty Formulations

Sutures, oncology formulations, and generic alternatives tailored for animal health practices.

[img]

### Trusted Distribution

Compliant with all state and federal regulations to guarantee authentic, traceable supply for animal
care providers.

[Know more][21]
[img]

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## Licensed in All 50 States

With FDA registration and DSCSA 2025 readiness, our 50-state licensing ensures healthcare providers
across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.

[img]

## OUR PARTNERS

We work with companies and manufacturers worldwide.

Entrepreneur India is a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS),
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

## About the Magazine

Entrepreneur India is a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS),
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.
