## A Leading International Pharmaceutical Company located in Greece

The story of the Gerolymatos International **Pharma** began almost 100 years ago in 1923, when
pharmacist, Nikos Gerolymatos, opened his own pharmacy in the heart of Athens. The pharmacy became
one of the largest in the country and the small family business grew. Guided by the dedication of
its founder, the entrepreneurial spirit of his son, Panagiotis, and now his grandson, Nicholas,
Gerolymatos International, is today, one of the most historical, traditional and well-regarded
family businesses in the Greek healthcare industry.

Based in Athens, Greece, with affiliated companies in France, Italy and Cyprus, Gerolymatos
International has a significant **global presence in over 50 countries **worldwide through exclusive
distribution partnerships for its own brand portfolio, namely, **Sinomarin®** (natural nasal & ear
care sea water sprays & vials -medical devices) & **Tamarine®** (pharmaceutical natural laxative in
marmalade form).

With a fully-owned pumping and processing installation for sea water in the northern French Britany
coast –the cleanest, most pristine waters- and a dedicated manufacturing facility in Athens, Greece,
Gerolymatos International produces its Sinomarin product lines for 40 international markets. The
company also provides **contract manufacturing** for hypertonic and isotonic **seawater-based nasal
sprays** and has become a leading **sea water nasal spray manufacturer**, delivering highest quality
products on private label.

Gerolymatos International is committed to pharmaceutical manufacturing, research & development,
marketing, distribution and sales of its own of its own product lines as well as the exclusive
distribution of products from highly esteemed international partners.

With an enduring presence in the Greek domestic market, the company operates in three distinct
segments:
* **OTC division**: caters to the Pharmacy and Supermarket channels, marketing the Company’s own
  brands, and exclusively distributes a wide range of imported OTC products such as **Biofreeze**
  external pain relief portfolio and **Hipp** **organic baby milks and foods**,
* **Optics division**: exclusively distributes the **Alcon Vision Care** product portfolio including
  contact lenses, solutions and eye drops,
* **Vet division**: exclusively distributes the veterinary pharmaceutical product portfolio of
  **Boehringer Ingelheim** and **Affinity Petcare’s** clinical nutrition portfolio.

The company’s extended business network in Greece and abroad includes Pharmaceutical companies and
healthcare professionals such as medical doctors, veterinarians, opticians and pharmacists, amongst
other specialties.

## A Leading International Pharmaceutical Company located in Greece

The story of the Gerolymatos International **Pharma** began almost 100 years ago in 1923, when
pharmacist, Nikos Gerolymatos, opened his own pharmacy in the heart of Athens. The pharmacy became
one of the largest in the country and the small family business grew. Guided by the dedication of
its founder, the entrepreneurial spirit of his son, Panagiotis, and now his grandson, Nicholas,
Gerolymatos International, is today, one of the most historical, traditional and well-regarded
family businesses in the Greek healthcare industry.

Based in Athens, Greece, with affiliated companies in France, Italy and Cyprus, Gerolymatos
International has a significant **global presence in over 50 countries **worldwide through exclusive
distribution partnerships for its own brand portfolio, namely, **Sinomarin®** (natural nasal & ear
care sea water sprays & vials -medical devices) & **Tamarine®** (pharmaceutical natural laxative in
marmalade form).

With a fully-owned pumping and processing installation for sea water in the northern French Britany
coast –the cleanest, most pristine waters- and a dedicated manufacturing facility in Athens, Greece,
Gerolymatos International produces its Sinomarin product lines for 40 international markets. The
company also provides **contract manufacturing** for hypertonic and isotonic **seawater-based nasal
sprays** and has become a leading **sea water nasal spray manufacturer**, delivering highest quality
products on private label.

Gerolymatos International is committed to pharmaceutical manufacturing, research & development,
marketing, distribution and sales of its own of its own product lines as well as the exclusive
distribution of products from highly esteemed international partners.

With an enduring presence in the Greek domestic market, the company operates in three distinct
segments:
* **OTC division**: caters to the Pharmacy and Supermarket channels, marketing the Company’s own
  brands, and exclusively distributes a wide range of imported OTC products such as **Biofreeze**
  external pain relief portfolio and **Hipp** **organic baby milks and foods**,
* **Optics division**: exclusively distributes the **Alcon Vision Care** product portfolio including
  contact lenses, solutions and eye drops,
* **Vet division**: exclusively distributes the veterinary pharmaceutical product portfolio of
  **Boehringer Ingelheim** and **Affinity Petcare’s** clinical nutrition portfolio.

The company’s extended business network in Greece and abroad includes Pharmaceutical companies and
healthcare professionals such as medical doctors, veterinarians, opticians and pharmacists, amongst
other specialties.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## Your team has ideas,

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

Tablets

coated, chewable and more.

supplements & tonics.

Injectables

available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

# Medical Device Innovations for ENT

Hogne is a cutting-edge medical technology company specializing in innovations and products within
the field of oto-rhino-laryngology, focusing on the areas of ear, nose, and throat. With a strong
commitment to advancing healthcare, Hogne AB continuously strives to revolutionize the medical
industry through groundbreaking solutions.

[
Advancing Precision Medicine

### Nasal Drug Delivery

Explore our patented TrigeNas™ platform — a multi-route nasal delivery technology unlocking direct
and efficient access to the brain and bloodstream.

Läs mer
][23][
Redefining Everyday Care

### Consumer Products

Discover our clinically designed consumer solutions that combine comfort, safety, and efficiency —
empowering patients to treat common ENT conditions with ease.

Läs mer
][24]

## Our mission

At HOGNE AB,our mission is to revolutionize healthcare through the development and delivery of
first-in-class medtech devices for the ear, nose, and throat (ENT) areas.

We are dedicated to improving the lives of people on a global basis by providing innovative and
effective solutions that enhance the treatment and overall well-being of individuals with ENT
conditions.

We strive to be at the forefront of technological advancements in the medical field, constantly
pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Our team of passionate and skilled professionals
work tirelessly to develop groundbreaking devices that address unmet needs and redefine the standard
of care in ENT treatments.

[
Read More
][25]
Hogne is dedicated to fostering strong partnerships with healthcare institutions, research
organizations, and regulatory bodies, working together to drive advancements in ENT medicine.

## Focus Areas

Hogne strive to develop cutting-edge medical devices that address a wide range of ENT conditions,
like:

### Epistaxis - common nosebleed

][26]
[

### External otitis - swimmer's ear

][27]
[

### Dry ears

][28]
[

### Nasal drug delivery

### Nasal vaccine delivery

][30]

## Our Core Values

### Innovation & Research

Our dedicated R&D team works tirelessly to explore new possibilities, technologies, and treatment
options.

### Patient-Centric Approach

By focusing on usability, comfort, and effectiveness, we aim to make medical treatments more
accessible.

### Quality & Compliance

We adhere to the highest industry standards and regulations to ensure the safety and efficacy of our
products.

Read More

Therapeutic focus

## Four specialty areas. Each chosen for clinical need.

We register and supply medicines in therapeutic areas where Kenyan patients face the largest access
gaps and where consistent, quality-assured supply matters most for clinical outcomes.

[
[Cispire 50 — Cisplatin Injection B.P.]

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

[Contact our team][22]
For healthcare professionals

## Need product information, availability or supply support?

Our scientific office responds to medical-information requests, hospital-procurement enquiries and
tender queries within one working day.

* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Manufacturing
# **More Tomorrows**^{TM}

**Helping you fast-track healthier futures.**

As a purpose-fueled drug delivery CDMO, we leverage our specialist injectable, inhalation and dermal
expertise to accelerate your product’s journey and make tomorrow’s possibilities a reality.

[ CDMO solutions ][45] [ Drug delivery expertise ][46]

## Innovative CDMO solutions

From development to commercial manufacturing and beyond, amplify your product’s impact with our
exceptional-by-design CDMO solutions.

[ Learn more about our solutions ][47]

## Connect with us

Our Bridgeton facility has over 155,000 sq. ft. of dedicated aseptic operations space, including
state-of-the-art laboratories and formulation suites, alongside almost 11,000 sq. ft. of fill suites
to ensure the highest levels of quality and patient safety.

[ Explore our facilities ][48] [ Explore our Bridgeton facility ][49]

## We’re hiring

Join us and become part of a CDMO dedicated to advancing our clients’ projects, ambitions and our
industry.

[
View all open vacancies ][50] [ Culture and values ][51]

Our legacy of innovation

## History of Kindeva

Since 1956, we have been developing technologies that meet the demands of today and deliver the
possibilities of tomorrow.

2024

### Developing low-GWP inhalers

Developing low-GWP inhalers and planning the opening of one of the first commercial-scale green
propellant lines for filling inhalers using propellants with up to 99.9% lower GWP than current
options.

2012

### Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI

Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI**,** a more environmentally sound device for drug delivery capable
of bypassing the blood-brain barrier.

[Analytical testing of plastic syringe for USP 661.2 compliance – Kindeva lab]

2010

### Developed the first commercially available dose counter

Developed the first commercially available dose counter, ensuring patients knew the number of
inhaler actuations remaining so they could always be prepared.

2009

### Created the TruJect™ platform

Created the TruJect™ platform and introduced the next generation of easy and reliable single-chamber
autoinjectors, widely used to deliver a variety of medications.

2005

### Solid microneedle array patch development

Solid microneedle array patch development, creating accurate, reliable intradermal delivery with the
potential to eliminate cold-chain storage and enhance immunogenicity and efficacy.

2002

### Invented the BinaJect® platform

Invented the BinaJect® platform, bringing an industry-leading dual-chamber autoinjector option to
market with enhanced stability and bioavailability.

1995

### Launched the CFC-free MDI

Launched the CFC-free MDI and set the standard for future care options developed to help safeguard
the environment.

1989

### Developed the breath-actuated inhaler

Developed the breath-actuated inhaler, a lifesaving option for individuals with hand-breath
coordination problems that make traditional inhalers difficult to use.

1970

### Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch

Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch, providing a noninvasive method for delivering a drug over an
extended timeframe.

2024

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

# Advancing Topical & Transepithelial Therapies from Concept to Commercial

MedPharm partners with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to develop, test, and manufacture
topical and transepithelial products — reducing risk and accelerating the path to patients.

[ Connect with Our Team ][75] [ View Our Services ][76]

Expertise Across Multiple Routes of Delivery

[ [Dermal and Transdermal Delivery] ][77]

## Integrated Solutions

‹
[Formulation Development]

### Formulation Development

Strategic formulation development for topical and transepithelial drug products, focused on
optimizing delivery, stability, and patient performance.

[Analytical & Testing Services]

### Analytical & Testing Services

Comprehensive analytical and testing services to support development, quality, and regulatory
requirements, delivering reliable data to guide critical decisions.

[Commercial Manufacturing]

### Commercial Manufacturing

Scalable GMP manufacturing for semi-solid and liquid drug products, supporting clinical supply
through commercial production with quality and consistency.

[Process Development & Scale-Up]

### Process Development & Scale-Up

Process development and scale-up to translate formulations from lab to manufacturing, ensuring
robust, reproducible performance at commercial scale.

IVRT, IVPT, and Research Biology models to evaluate drug release, permeation, and pharmacological
activity across development.

Clinical trial material manufacturing and supply to support early- and late-stage studies, ensuring
quality, consistency, and reliable delivery.

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### View All Resources for Providers

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

# Medicare
# Pharma

Somos un distribuidor farmacéutico autorizado como ‘Entidad de Distribución Farmacéutica Mayorista
de Medicamentos de Uso Humano’ con más de 15 años de experiencia.

La calidad de nuestro servicio está avalada, entre otros, por el Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de
Distribución (BPD), y contamos con las certificaciones ISO 9001:2015 e ISO 14001:2015.

Estamos especializados en distribución de medicamentos y productos hospitalarios de uso humano y
enfermedades raras. 

Medicare Pharma está compuesta por un equipo de profesionales formados y cualificados en el sector,
avalados con más de 30 años de experiencia en puestos de liderazgo en importantes compañías
nacionales e internacionales dentro de la industria farmacéutica, lo que nos permite aportar una
visión clara y completa a nuestros clientes.

Además, contamos con socios independientes y especializados en el área de desarrollo de negocio,
permitiendo aportar valor estratégico en las fases de implantación, desarrollo y consolidación del
modelo de negocio escogido por cada cliente.

## MISIÓN

### Distribución Farmacéutica

Control de la cadena de distribución de medicamentos, desde su importación hasta su dispensación,
garantizando la calidad de los mismos y asegurando las adecuadas condiciones de conservación,
transporte y suministro. Cumplimos con la normativa europea y contamos con la correspondiente
autorización de almacén distribución. Estamos especializados en la gestión de Medicamentos en
Situaciones Especiales teniendo como misión evitar lagunas terapéuticas ante la falta de suministro
de medicamentos en nuestro país.

### Representación local

Somos representantes locales de los laboratorios que distribuimos para el territorio español. Somos
los interlocutores autorizados con las administraciones oficiales ejerciendo las funciones y
asumiendo las responsabilidades derivadas.

### Responsabilidad

Las competencias y medios de Medicare Pharma garantizan cubrir las necesidades de los laboratorios
con quienes trabajamos, garantizando la distribución, cumplir con el marco regulatorio, gestionar la
relación con autoridades, controlar las licitaciones a nivel nacional, cubrir la farmacovigilancia,
registros y acceso a mercado.

### Red de ventas especializadas

Nuestro personal especializado con larga experiencia en el sector (departamento médico, MSL y Market
Access) cubre las funciones de introducción de productos en el mercado trabajando con los
especialistas, prescriptores y líderes de opinión de las distintas áreas terapéuticas.

### DISTRIBUCIÓN FARMACÉUTICA

Control de la cadena de distribución de medicamentos, desde su importación hasta su dispensación,
garantizando la calidad de los mismos y asegurando las adecuadas condiciones de conservación,
transporte y suministro. Cumplimos con la normativa europea y contamos con la correspondiente
autorización de almacén distribución. Estamos especializados en la gestión de Medicamentos en
Situaciones Especiales teniendo como misión evitar lagunas terapéuticas ante la falta de suministro

# Medicare
# Pharma

Somos un distribuidor farmacéutico autorizado como ‘Entidad de Distribución Farmacéutica Mayorista
de Medicamentos de Uso Humano’ con más de 15 años de experiencia.

La calidad de nuestro servicio está avalada, entre otros, por el Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de
Distribución (BPD), y contamos con las certificaciones ISO 9001:2015 e ISO 14001:2015.

Estamos especializados en distribución de medicamentos y productos hospitalarios de uso humano y
enfermedades raras. 

Medicare Pharma está compuesta por un equipo de profesionales formados y cualificados en el sector,
avalados con más de 30 años de experiencia en puestos de liderazgo en importantes compañías
nacionales e internacionales dentro de la industria farmacéutica, lo que nos permite aportar una
visión clara y completa a nuestros clientes.

Además, contamos con socios independientes y especializados en el área de desarrollo de negocio,
permitiendo aportar valor estratégico en las fases de implantación, desarrollo y consolidación del
modelo de negocio escogido por cada cliente.

## MISIÓN

### Distribución Farmacéutica

Control de la cadena de distribución de medicamentos, desde su importación hasta su dispensación,
garantizando la calidad de los mismos y asegurando las adecuadas condiciones de conservación,
transporte y suministro. Cumplimos con la normativa europea y contamos con la correspondiente
autorización de almacén distribución. Estamos especializados en la gestión de Medicamentos en
Situaciones Especiales teniendo como misión evitar lagunas terapéuticas ante la falta de suministro
de medicamentos en nuestro país.

### Representación local

Somos representantes locales de los laboratorios que distribuimos para el territorio español. Somos
los interlocutores autorizados con las administraciones oficiales ejerciendo las funciones y
asumiendo las responsabilidades derivadas.

### Responsabilidad

Las competencias y medios de Medicare Pharma garantizan cubrir las necesidades de los laboratorios
con quienes trabajamos, garantizando la distribución, cumplir con el marco regulatorio, gestionar la
relación con autoridades, controlar las licitaciones a nivel nacional, cubrir la farmacovigilancia,
registros y acceso a mercado.

### Red de ventas especializadas

Nuestro personal especializado con larga experiencia en el sector (departamento médico, MSL y Market
Access) cubre las funciones de introducción de productos en el mercado trabajando con los
especialistas, prescriptores y líderes de opinión de las distintas áreas terapéuticas.

### DISTRIBUCIÓN FARMACÉUTICA

Control de la cadena de distribución de medicamentos, desde su importación hasta su dispensación,
garantizando la calidad de los mismos y asegurando las adecuadas condiciones de conservación,
transporte y suministro. Cumplimos con la normativa europea y contamos con la correspondiente
autorización de almacén distribución. Estamos especializados en la gestión de Medicamentos en
Situaciones Especiales teniendo como misión evitar lagunas terapéuticas ante la falta de suministro
de medicamentos en nuestro país.

### REPRESENTACIÓN LOCAL DE MEDICAMENTOS

Somos representantes locales de los laboratorios que distribuimos para el territorio español. Somos
los interlocutores autorizados con las administraciones oficiales ejerciendo las funciones y
asumiendo las responsabilidades derivadas.

### RESPONSABILIDAD

relación con autoridades, controlar las licitaciones a nivel nacional, cubrir la farmacovigilancia,

### RED DE VENTAS ESPECIALIZADAS

SmartTrack™ - Transforming Bioequivalence for Inhaled Drug Products
OINDP Development Specialists
Integrated Analytical Services
In-Vitro & In-Silico Modeling

## Nanopharm SmartTrack ™

Nanopharm has developed a unique proprietary in-vitro in-silico modeling system that can demonstrate
the comparative bioequivalence (BE) of inhaled generic drug products to reference listed products
without conducting a comparative clinical endpoint (CCEP) study.

[ Learn More About SmartTrack™ ][55]
[Round blue Nanopharm SmartTrack infographic showing 5 key parts of the in-silico in-vitro modelling
platform at Nanopharm.]

# Your Specialist CRO For Nasal & Inhaled Drug Products

Nanopharm is focused on providing highly specialized OINDP development and analytical services that
accelerate the development of your drug-device combination product and help bring it to market
faster.

Nanopharm applies its specialized expertise across a range of OINDP drug delivery formats and
molecule types. Our specialty is developing nasal and inhaled drug delivery products for small
molecules or biologics in combination with a variety of devices suitable for innovator, generic, or
lifecycle management applications.

## Nanopharm's OINDP Development Services

Our scientists are dedicated to advancing customer OINDP products from early development to cGMP
clinical stages and providing ongoing analytical support through to commercialization and beyond.
With over 20 years of experience developing some of the world’s most advanced nasal, inhaled, and
inhaled biologic products, Nanopharm offers the right support and services for virtually every stage
of your drug product’s development. All our services are backed by world-class regulatory support
and unrivaled scientific expertise.

As part of Aptar Pharma’s strategic expansion to support early-stage drug development, Nanopharm now
integrates the clinical trial manufacturing capabilities available at our newly acquired [Aptar
Pharma Services site in Boonton, NJ][56], a recognized leader in Phase 1 and 2 fill and finish
services for Orally Inhaled and Nasal Drug Products (OINDPs). This acquisition strengthens our
ability to offer end-to-end support from early development through clinical supply. Aptar Pharma
Services’ Boonton site combines decades of CMC experience with a laser focus on OINDPs to transform
your project into a clinic-ready proposition.

Using a stage-appropriate methodology within the Module 3 framework, our experts work
collaboratively with you to manage risk, mitigate delay and reduce cost while ensuring your OINDP
product’s quality, safety, and efficacy.

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

Original prescription strength

[ambulance_icon]

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.

# NARCAN^{®} NASAL SPRAY – ANYONE CAN SAVE A LIFE

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

[injection_icon (4)]

Easy to use. No nasal swabs or needles

[shield_icon (2)]

Safe to use, even if opioids are not present

[prescription_icon]

Original prescription strength

[clock_icon]

Works quickly, often reversing an opioid overdose in minutes

[ambulance_icon]

Same brand used by first responders

[Hand Spraying Narcan Nasal Spray]

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.
Lay Spray Stay

### About Conference



After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites

**Why you should attend?**
* Access to senior-level executives from leading international pharmaceutical & [biotechnology
  companies][93]

  U.S., Europe and Asia

  clinical and commercial mind set.
* Discover the latest innovations in [drug delivery][97] devices.

  delivery processes.
* Engage in the exciting event format, with round tables, panels, showcases, speed networking and
  multiple conference tracks.
* Share experiences, insights and strategies in interactive peer to peer round tables.
* Hear more perspectives in one place – from large medium and small organizations from pharma,
  biotech and academia.
* Discover how scientific formulation advancements are being implemented in practice.

### Sessions & Tracks


**Track 1:** [**Bio-Pharmaceutics**][98]

[Bio Pharmaceutics conferences][99] plays an important role in [drug discovery][100] like drug
disposition, Innovations in clinical development, Pharmaceutical technology, Pharmaceutics and drug
delivery, Drug design, Targeted drug, gene delivery,  [Sustained drug delivery system][101], Routes
of administration, Fundamental drug development.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][102] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][103] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 2: **[**Pharmaceutical Chemistry**][104]

Pharmaceutical Chemistry is the study of drug design to optimize pharmacokinetics and
pharmacodynamics, and synthesis of new drug molecules. [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][105] is a branch
of chemistry that deals with the chemical, biochemical and pharmacological aspects of drugs. It
includes synthesis/isolation, identification, structural elucidation, structural
modification, [structural activity relationship][106] (SAR) studies, and study of the chemical
characteristics, biochemical changes after drug administration and their pharmacological effects as
well as analysis of drugs. In more simple words it is more broader than [medicinal
chemistry][107] in its application also in the fields of analysis, identification, as well as,
structural elucidation of drugs.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  [Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union][108] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia |Pharmacy in China | [Danish Association of Pharmaconomists][109]

**Track 3: **[**Drug Targeting and Design**][110]

[Drug design][111], often referred to as [rational drug design][112] or simply rational design, is
the inventive process of finding new medications based on the knowledge of a biological target. The
drug is most commonly an organic small molecule that activates or inhibits the function of a
biomolecule such as a protein, which in turn results in a therapeutic benefit to the patient. In the
most basic sense, drug design involves the design of molecules that are complementary in shape and
charge to the biomolecular target with which they interact and therefore will bind to it. Drug
design frequently but not necessarily relies on computer modeling techniques. This type of modeling
is sometimes referred to as [computer-aided drug design][113]. Finally, drug design that relies on
the knowledge of the three-dimensional structure of the biomolecular target is known as
structure-based drug design. In addition to small molecules, [biopharmaceuticals][114] and
especially therapeutic antibodies are an increasingly important class of drugs and computational
methods for improving the affinity, selectivity, and stability of this protein-based therapeutics
have also been developed.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][115] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][116] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 4: **[**Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs**][117]

Pharmacokinetics is currently defined as the study of the time course of drug absorption,
distribution, metabolism, and excretion. Clinical [pharmacokinetics][118] is the application of
pharmacokinetic principles to the safe and effective therapeutic management of drugs in an
individual patient. Primary goals of clinical pharmacokinetics include enhancing efficacy and
decreasing [toxicity][119] of a patient’s drug therapy. The development of strong correlations
between drug concentrations and their pharmacologic responses has enabled clinicians to apply
pharmacokinetic principles to actual patient situations.

[Pharmacodynamics][120] refers to the relationship between drug concentration at the site of action
and the resulting effect, including the time course and intensity of therapeutic and adverse
effects. The effect of a drug present at the site of action is determined by that drug’s binding
with a receptor.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  [American College of Clinical
Pharmacy][121] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia][1

Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

[Novel drug delivery systems Conference][83] is one of the well-established conference
among [Pharmaceutical Conferences][84] organized by Conference Series

Pharmaceutica 2026 covers various aspects of Bio-Pharmaceutics, [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][85], Drug
Targeting and Design, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs, Pharmaceutical Formulation,
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Nanotechnology, [Novel Drug Delivery Systems][86],
Smart Drug Delivery Systems, [Nano medicine][87] and Biomedical Applications, Biomaterials in Drug
Delivery, Vaccine Drug Delivery Systems, Medical Devices for [Drug Delivery][88], Biologics
& [Biosimilars][89], Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Process Validation, Pharmaceutical
Packaging, [Clinical Trials][90] and [Clinical Research][91], Pharmacogenetics and Genomics,
Regulatory Affairs and Intellectual Property Rights, Industrial and Physical Pharmacy, Clinical and
Hospital Pharmacy, [Pharmacovigilance][92] and Drug Safety, Pharmacy Education and Practice

**2026 Highlights:**
* 200+ Participation (70% Industry: 30% Academia)
* 9+ Keynote Speakers
* 30+ Plenary Speakers
* 3+ Exhibitors
* 14 Innovative Educational Sessions
* B2B Meetings

**Why you should attend?**
* Access to senior-level executives from leading international pharmaceutical & [biotechnology
  companies][93]
* Exposure to new and exciting companies ready for partnerships and licensing opportunities in the
  U.S., Europe and Asia
* Tremendous networking opportunities to meet numerous U.S., European, Japanese and Asian biotech
  and [pharmaceutical companies][94] in one place at one time
* Use of state-of-the-art partnering technology
* Targeted partner selections through proprietary screening process
* Get to the heart of why [formulation][95] and delivery strategies fail. Dissect the challenges
  before looking for concrete solutions.
* Discover how advances in the sector are impacting both large and small molecule drugs.
* Explore tried and tested routes to improve [bioavailability][96].
* Understand how to develop the right formulation and delivery strategy with a strong scientific,
  clinical and commercial mind set.
* Discover the latest innovations in [drug delivery][97] devices.
* Be inspired by innovative case studies and realize the potential impact on your formulation or
  delivery processes.
* Engage in the exciting event format, with round tables, panels, showcases, speed networking and
  multiple conference tracks.
* Share experiences, insights and strategies in interactive peer to peer round tables.
* Hear more perspectives in one place – from large medium and small organizations from pharma,
  biotech and academia.
* Discover how scientific formulation advancements are being implemented in practice.

**Who Should Attend**

### Sessions & Tracks


**Track 1:** [**Bio-Pharmaceutics**][98]

[Bio Pharmaceutics conferences][99] plays an important role in [drug discovery][100] like drug
disposition, Innovations in clinical development, Pharmaceutical technology, Pharmaceutics and drug
delivery, Drug design, Targeted drug, gene delivery,  [Sustained drug delivery system][101], Routes
of administration, Fundamental drug development.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][102] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][103] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 2: **[**Pharmaceutical Chemistry**][104]

Pharmaceutical Chemistry is the study of drug design to optimize pharmacokinetics and
pharmacodynamics, and synthesis of new drug molecules. [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][105] is a branch
of chemistry that deals with the chemical, biochemical and pharmacological aspects of drugs. It
includes synthesis/isolation, identification, structural elucidation, structural
modification, [structural activity relationship][106] (SAR) studies, and study of the chemical
characteristics, biochemical changes after drug administration and their pharmacological effects as
well as analysis of drugs. In more simple words it is more broader than [medicinal
chemistry][107] in its application also in the fields of analysis, identification, as well as,
structural elucidation of drugs.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  [Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union][108] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia |Pharmacy in China | [Danish Association of Pharmaconomists][109]

**Track 3: **[**Drug Targeting and Design**][110]

[Drug design][111], often referred to as [rational drug design][112] or simply rational design, is
the inventive process of finding new medications based on the knowledge of a biological target. The
drug is most commonly an organic small molecule that activates or inhibits the function of a
biomolecule such as a protein, which in turn results in a therapeutic benefit to the patient. In the
most basic sense, drug design involves the design of molecules that are complementary in shape and
charge to the biomolecular target with which they interact and therefore will bind to it. Drug
design frequently but not necessarily relies on computer modeling techniques. This type of modeling
is sometimes referred to as [computer-aided drug design][113]. Finally, drug design that relies on
the knowledge of the three-dimensional structure of the biomolecular target is known as
structure-based drug design. In addition to small molecules, [biopharmaceuticals][114] and
especially therapeutic antibodies are an increasingly important class of drugs and computational
methods for improving the affinity, selectivity, and stability of this protein-based therapeutics
have also been developed.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  International Pharmaceutical Federation | [Pharmaceutical
Group of the European Union][115] |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of
Australia][116] | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of
Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

**Track 4: **[**Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs**][117]

Pharmacokinetics is currently defined as the study of the time course of drug absorption,
distribution, metabolism, and excretion. Clinical [pharmacokinetics][118] is the application of
pharmacokinetic principles to the safe and effective therapeutic management of drugs in an
individual patient. Primary goals of clinical pharmacokinetics include enhancing efficacy and
decreasing [toxicity][119] of a patient’s drug therapy. The development of strong correlations
between drug concentrations and their pharmacologic responses has enabled clinicians to apply
pharmacokinetic principles to actual patient situations.

[Pharmacodynamics][120] refers to the relationship between drug concentration at the site of action
and the resulting effect, including the time course and intensity of therapeutic and adverse
effects. The effect of a drug present at the site of action is determined by that drug’s binding
with a receptor.

**Related Associations and Societies**:  [American College of Clinical
Pharmacy][121] | International Pharmaceutical Federation | Pharmaceutical Group of the European
Union |  [The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia][1

therapy to expand beyond niche specialist clinics and hospitals. ][168]

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

# We Are a Company With a Clear Vision

Optinose is a specialty pharmaceutical company focused on creating and bringing to market innovative
products for patients with diseases treated by ear, nose, and throat (ENT) and allergy specialists.
Our mission is to improve the quality of life for patients. We will accomplish that by becoming the
leading specialty pharmaceutical company dedicated to creating innovative products that become
standard of care for diseases cared for directly by, or in consultation with, ENT and allergy
specialists.

Our first product for these patients uses one of our patented Bi-Directional™ Exhalation Delivery
Systems (EDS) to uniquely deliver a potent steroid deep into the nose where inflammation can be hard
to reach. Our EDS technology has other applications, such as in treatment of neurological or
psychiatric disorders.

Although these areas are not our focus, we have already successfully developed and out-licensed one
product in that space, and plan to partner with organizations who focus on central nervous system
treatments to develop more. 

[ GET ACQUAINTED ][22]

# We Are a Company With a Purpose

The Optinose team is unified by a common shared mission: to improve lives. We will accomplish this
while creating value for investors and the healthcare system along with better outcomes for patients
and providers. As innovators in every aspect of our work, we will pursue faster and less costly
product development, explore evolving commercial business models, and actively seek innovative ways
to be more effective and efficient. We are committed to working together as a team that chooses to
live every day by core company values that guide our daily behaviors, creating a foundation for
future success.

[ DESIGNED WITH PURPOSE ][23]

## Introducing Exhalation
## Delivery Systems

At Optinose, we are breaking through the conventional ways of thinking and doing. We are focused on
value creation, starting with our work on a unique and novel drug delivery concept known as
Bi-Directional Exhalation Delivery Systems. Our current efforts are centered on developing highly
differentiated products for large, underserved markets where EDS technology could redefine the
standard of care because it can deliver medication to where it’s needed.

[ SEE EDS IN ACTION ][24]
[scintigraphy-animation]

## Delivery System. Both images are from the same subject and are representative of the overall
## findings from 211 images and 56 subjects. The clinical relevance of different deposition patterns
## has not been established.

### [image_device]Our Products

Our now-approved lead product, XHANCE^{®} (fluticasone propionate), has the potential to become an
important treatment option for patients who continue to have unmet needs despite the availability of
multiple treatments.

[ EXPLORE XHANCE® ][25]

### Research & Development

The list of Optinose candidates currently being developed includes:
* XHANCE for chronic sinusitis

We have also identified multiple follow-on pipeline candidates that we believe have outstanding
potential to bring new clinical benefits to patients by virtue of our Bi-Directional Exhalation
Delivery Systems.

### [image_device]Our Products

Our now-approved lead product, XHANCE^{®} (fluticasone propionate), has the potential to become an
important treatment option for patients who continue to have unmet needs despite the availability of
multiple treatments.

[ EXPLORE XHANCE® ][25]

### Research & Development

The list of Optinose candidates currently being developed includes:
* XHANCE for chronic sinusitis

We have also identified multiple follow-on pipeline candidates that we believe have outstanding
potential to bring new clinical benefits to patients by virtue of our Bi-Directional Exhalation
Delivery Systems.

## NASAL
