# Breathing innovation into nasal drug delivery

The nose offers great potential as a patient-friendly pathway for local and systemic drug delivery.
Our expertise and technical capabilities in the development and manufacturing of nasal drug products
are designed to ensure that potential is realised for pharma partners.

## Key services for pharmaceutical partners
* **Nasal spray manufacturing capabilities**
  
  Our broad expertise in nasal drug delivery spans the entire product development cycle from
  formulation science to scale-up manufacture. Whether working with unit-dose, bi-dose or multi-dose
  products (preserved and sterile/non-preserved), the capabilities offered by our skilled in-house
  scientists and engineers ensures we can support any nasal project at any stage.
* **Nasal spray testing**
  
  Equipped with a state-of-the-art laboratory, we have the capabilities to conduct a wide range of
  nasal spray testing services across unit-dose, bi-dose and multi-dose devices, covering everything
  from particle-size distribution to plume geometry. The combination of detailed spray
  characterisation and decades of experience enable us to enhance and accelerate product
  development.
* **Nasal spray development**
  
  We are a specialist CDMO for nasal drug products, and our experience in the sector runs deep
  throughout the organisation. That means our partners can lean on our authoritative knowledge to
  guide and advance projects at any stage, from initial concept and testing through to device
  selection and commercialisation.
* **Site transfer**
  
  Balancing rigorous structure with the ability to flex manufacturing capacity, we can support the
  seamless transfer of intranasal products currently in commercial production. The process is
  closely monitored and managed by our experienced project managers, who are assigned to ensure
  project deadlines are met and transition to the facility is completed smoothly.
* **Aseptic filling**
  
  Our expertise in aseptic filling perfectly complements our device development services. Supported
  by advanced contamination control strategies and enhanced by automated inspection systems, our
  filling operations meet the highest regulatory requirements. We are equipped to handle a broad
  spectrum of sterile manufacturing needs, including small molecules, biologics, potent compounds
  and controlled substances (DEA Schedule I–V).
* **Packaging**
  
  Our flexible, customisable secondary packaging solutions ensure the finishing touch is applied at
  the end of the manufacturing process. Packaging options are tailored to each particular nasal drug
  product, whether in the form of blister packaging for micro-dose devices or automated cartoning.
  We ensure the end result delivers on all requirements, from data serialisation and product
  security to brand promotion.

### Key benefits for patients
* Convenient, needle-free drug delivery
* Local and systemic acting
* Rapid onset
* Improved bioavailability
* Bypasses problems with oral delivery

## Aseptic Filling

In the manufacturing of nasal spray and ophthalmic drug products, quality and safety are paramount.
Pharma companies must be able to rely on a trusted partner with the knowledge and capabilities to
deliver service excellence in compliance with the latest regulatory standards.
At LTS, we have the capacity, expertise and experience to support a full spectrum of aseptic
processing and sterilization services for products including small molecules, biologics, controlled
substances (DEA Schedule I-V).
Our modern filling operations integrate advanced contamination control strategies and highly
automated systems for inspection and packaging, ensuring consistent quality, efficiency, and
reliable product release. Each year, multiple inspections by customers and international regulatory
agencies confirm our adherence to the highest standards – reinforcing our proven track record in
sterile drug delivery.

### Features of filling lines
* Aseptic nasal spray filler
* High-speed filling
* Small-batch filling: Clinical trial and development batches
* Glass vials: 3.5 ml & 7.5 ml
* In-line vial washing and depyrogenation

## Our core products

Our capabilities span both development and commercial scale manufacturing of unit dose, bi dose, and
multi dose nasal sprays, all produced in state of the art, environmentally controlled facilities.
With a strong track record of regulatory approvals, we can seamlessly onboard projects at any point
in their lifecycle—from early concept development and formulation optimization to clinical
manufacturing and the transfer of established commercial products.

### Micro Dose

[uni dose]

**Unit-dose nasal spray**

This patient-ready, primeless device precisely delivers a single dose via one-handed actuation. The
drug product is filled and secured within a speciality micro glass vial prior to product assembly,
with a standard 100μl (microliter) dose. Micro Dose is suitable for both local and systemic
therapies and can support effective lifecycle management strategies for existing brands through the
addition of its simple, 360° functionality.

**Bi-dose nasal spray**

Enabling the precision delivery of up to 200μl of drug product to the patient via two nasal sprays.
In the case of both the bi-dose and unit-dose products, vial stoppering is critical to device
performance, and we ensure it is closely controlled through the provision of both mechanical and
vacuum stoppering at clinical and commercial scale.

[bi dose]

### Multi dose

[multi dose]

Comprehensive manufacturing capabilities to support the production of multi-dose nasal spray devices
that consistently and repeatedly deliver an accurate measured dose. Our environmentally controlled
filling facilities ensure both preserved and sterile (non-preserved) multi-dose formulations are

# Breathing innovation into nasal drug delivery

The nose offers great potential as a patient-friendly pathway for local and systemic drug delivery.
Our expertise and technical capabilities in the development and manufacturing of nasal drug products
are designed to ensure that potential is realised for pharma partners.

## Key services for pharmaceutical partners
* **Nasal spray manufacturing capabilities**
  
  Our broad expertise in nasal drug delivery spans the entire product development cycle from
  formulation science to scale-up manufacture. Whether working with unit-dose, bi-dose or multi-dose
  products (preserved and sterile/non-preserved), the capabilities offered by our skilled in-house
  scientists and engineers ensures we can support any nasal project at any stage.
* **Nasal spray testing**
  
  Equipped with a state-of-the-art laboratory, we have the capabilities to conduct a wide range of
  nasal spray testing services across unit-dose, bi-dose and multi-dose devices, covering everything
  from particle-size distribution to plume geometry. The combination of detailed spray
  characterisation and decades of experience enable us to enhance and accelerate product
  development.
* **Nasal spray development**
  
  We are a specialist CDMO for nasal drug products, and our experience in the sector runs deep
  throughout the organisation. That means our partners can lean on our authoritative knowledge to
  guide and advance projects at any stage, from initial concept and testing through to device
  selection and commercialisation.
* **Site transfer**
  
  Balancing rigorous structure with the ability to flex manufacturing capacity, we can support the
  seamless transfer of intranasal products currently in commercial production. The process is
  closely monitored and managed by our experienced project managers, who are assigned to ensure
  project deadlines are met and transition to the facility is completed smoothly.
* **Aseptic filling**
  
  Our expertise in aseptic filling perfectly complements our device development services. Supported
  by advanced contamination control strategies and enhanced by automated inspection systems, our
  filling operations meet the highest regulatory requirements. We are equipped to handle a broad
  spectrum of sterile manufacturing needs, including small molecules, biologics, potent compounds
  and controlled substances (DEA Schedule I–V).
* **Packaging**
  
  Our flexible, customisable secondary packaging solutions ensure the finishing touch is applied at
  the end of the manufacturing process. Packaging options are tailored to each particular nasal drug
  product, whether in the form of blister packaging for micro-dose devices or automated cartoning.
  We ensure the end result delivers on all requirements, from data serialisation and product
  security to brand promotion.

### Key benefits for patients
* Convenient, needle-free drug delivery
* Local and systemic acting
* Rapid onset
* Improved bioavailability
* Bypasses problems with oral delivery

## Aseptic Filling

In the manufacturing of nasal spray and ophthalmic drug products, quality and safety are paramount.
Pharma companies must be able to rely on a trusted partner with the knowledge and capabilities to
deliver service excellence in compliance with the latest regulatory standards.
At LTS, we have the capacity, expertise and experience to support a full spectrum of aseptic
processing and sterilization services for products including small molecules, biologics, controlled
substances (DEA Schedule I-V).
Our modern filling operations integrate advanced contamination control strategies and highly
automated systems for inspection and packaging, ensuring consistent quality, efficiency, and
reliable product release. Each year, multiple inspections by customers and international regulatory
agencies confirm our adherence to the highest standards – reinforcing our proven track record in
sterile drug delivery.

### Features of filling lines
* Aseptic nasal spray filler
* High-speed filling
* Small-batch filling: Clinical trial and development batches
* Glass vials: 3.5 ml & 7.5 ml
* In-line vial washing and depyrogenation

## Our core products

Our capabilities span both development and commercial scale manufacturing of unit dose, bi dose, and
multi dose nasal sprays, all produced in state of the art, environmentally controlled facilities.
With a strong track record of regulatory approvals, we can seamlessly onboard projects at any point
in their lifecycle—from early concept development and formulation optimization to clinical
manufacturing and the transfer of established commercial products.

### Micro Dose

[uni dose]

**Unit-dose nasal spray**

This patient-ready, primeless device precisely delivers a single dose via one-handed actuation. The
drug product is filled and secured within a speciality micro glass vial prior to product assembly,
with a standard 100μl (microliter) dose. Micro Dose is suitable for both local and systemic
therapies and can support effective lifecycle management strategies for existing brands through the
addition of its simple, 360° functionality.

**Bi-dose nasal spray**

Enabling the precision delivery of up to 200μl of drug product to the patient via two nasal sprays.
In the case of both the bi-dose and unit-dose products, vial stoppering is critical to device
performance, and we ensure it is closely controlled through the provision of both mechanical and
vacuum stoppering at clinical and commercial scale.

One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

22 January 2026
Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Environmental, Social, and Governance

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

# The medical device development people

We are a medical product development consultancy that thrives on solving complex healthcare
challenges. For the past 40 years we have helped our clients create award-winning medical devices,
applying user-centred design and engineering excellence to create solutions that improve patient
lives. How can we help you?

## Helping clients in the following areas:

[Drug delivery][Drug delivery]

#### Drug delivery

From novel targeted drug delivery approaches to implantable, parenteral and respiratory
technologies, we help you develop devices that stand out in the market while improving patient
outcomes.

Explore
[Explore][84]
[MedTech][MedTech]

#### MedTech

From cutting-edge medical technologies to award-winning products, we’ve helped MedTech start-ups
achieve unicorn status and change the face of healthcare.

Explore
[Explore][85]
[Digital health][Digital health]

#### Digital health

We support Pharma and MedTech companies across the full spectrum of digital health product
development, crafting digital tools that encourage adoption, drive positive behaviours and improve
patient outcomes.

Explore
[Explore][86]
[Cell and gene therapies][Cell and gene therapies]

#### Cell and gene therapies

From nanoencapsulation systems for personalised medicine, to integrating process analytical
technologies (PAT) into bioprocessing devices, we help our clients develop novel cell and gene
therapy solutions.

## Empowering Healthcare with Strategic Solutions

Access complete healthcare market research, with detailed analysis and insights to empower
businesses & make data-driven decisions.

Search

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

Detailed information of company and industry profiles, financial data, investment insights, business
periodicals, Mergers and Acquisitions along with the SWOT analysis.

### Segmental Analysis

Complete analysis of all the segments covered in the report, with their market dynamics to get an
overall understanding of the current market scenario.

### Market Share Analysis (MSA)

Evaluating competitive marketing effectiveness through Market Share Analysis (MSA) to gain a
complete sense of specific market that will impact your revenue.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

Need help?

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

# CDMO Services : Development and Manufacturing

## Your integrated CDMO partner of choice for oral, nasal, pulmonary and parenteral dosage forms.

As a leading Contract, Development and Manufacturing Organisation ([CDMO][40]) our defining traits
lie in our adaptability and nimbleness.

We align to your drug development needs from [pre-clinical to late phase manufacture][41], with a
science-led approach that delivers across oral solids, nasal, pulmonary and parenteral dosage forms.

Everything you need from pre-clinical to market, all in one place.

[ About Us ][42]
[Scale Up Tech Transfer CDMO]
[

## Formulation Development

Boost bioavailability, understand stability and choose a formulation strategy that delivers in the
clinic.
Learn more
][43]
[

## Oral Solid Drug Manufacturing

Expertise in the manufacture of tablets and capsules from clinical supply to late phase success.
Learn more
][44]
[

## Sterile Fill/Finish Manufacturing

Sterile fill-finish services that you can trust, within a state-of-the art facility- perfect for
small scale batch sizes.
Learn more
][45]
[

## Inhalation Drug Product Development

Experts in dry powder inhalation formulation development for nasal and pulmonary drug products.
Learn more
][46]

### CDMO Services

## Science-led expertise providing you with unparalleled project delivery.

Our team support you at each stage of your drug program lifecycle from pre-clinical to market.

Our CDMO services include [formulation development][47], [phase 1, phase 2 and phase 3 clinical
supply][48], [process scale-up and optimisation][49], [quality control,][50] [analytical development
and validation][51], and [registration activities.][52]

[ Explore our CDMO services ][53]
[

## Interactive Facility Tour.

Step inside our award-winning Trent Gateway facility, explore our R&D and QC laboratories, plus walk
through our GMP manufacturing suites.
View Tour
TOUR
][54]

### Outstanding Pharmaceutical Project Delivery

## The right conversations with
## experts across our business.

We keep the knowledge of your molecule within the same project team, from start to finish.

With oversight from an [Executive Leadership Team][55] member on every project, our approach ensures
continuity and access to subject matter expertise from across our business.

Science-led, quick decision-making and collaboration keep your project moving forward.

[ Project delivery approach ][56]
[Project Management Team Upperton Pharma]
[Drug Research and Development Facility]

### Drug Development and GMP Manufacturing Facility

## One site,
## for seamless progression through phases.

Our award-winning 60,000 sqft [development and manufacturing facility][57], Trent Gateway, provides
pathways to commercialisation with confidence. From oral solids and nasal, to inhalation and
parenteral dosage forms, we accelerate your molecule through clinical phases with one integrated
facility.
[ View Facility Tour ][58]

## Our Mission.

### **Passionate about science, we strive to build strong customer relationships and exceed their
### expectations. **

### **We develop and manufacture high-quality drug products and share in our customers’ dedication
### to change the lives of patients.**

Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Industry. We are a Global Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Exporting

comprising of Medicines spread over all the major therapeutic areas like Antibiotic, Antimalarial,

## Why use Zenodo?
* **Safe** — Your research is stored safely for the future in CERN’s Data Centre for as long as CERN
  exists
* **Trusted** — Built and operated by CERN and OpenAIRE to ensure that everyone can join in Open
  Science
* **Citeable** — Every upload is assigned a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), to make them citable
  and trackable
* **No waiting time** — Uploads are made available online as soon as you hit publish, and your DOI
  is registered within seconds
* **Open or closed** — Share e.g. anonymized clinical trial data with only medical professionals via
  our restricted access mode
* **Versioning** — Easily update your dataset with our versioning feature
* **GitHub integration** — Easily preserve your GitHub repository in Zenodo
* **Usage statistics** — All uploads display standards compliant usage statistics

# Drug and Biologic Delivery Systems

### Delivery device technology with a “patient-centric” focus.

We provide patient-centric delivery device technology and primary container packaging for
pharmaceutical, biotech and personal care companies worldwide. We combine novel technology and
technical services to provide solutions to challenging drug, biopharmaceutical, biologic or
botanical delivery applications tailored to meet your technical specifications and market
requirements. We utilize a technology platform approach in combination with technical services to
provide custom configured packaging and delivery systems for liquid, powder and reconstituted powder
formulations. Delivery systems for ophthalmic, systemic intranasal, nose to brain, sublingual,
buccal, and otic, routes of administration are available.

## [Routes of Drug Delivery][22]

We offer delivery device configurations for the following routes of administration

[][23]

### Ophthalmic

[][24]

### Intranasal

[][25]

### Nose to  Brain

[][26]

### Sublingual

[][27]

### Animal Care

## Analytical Services

Services include:
* Dispense Characterization via laser diffraction
* Dispense Plume Morphology via high speed video
* Aerodynamic Deposition (in-vitro upper and lower respiratory tracks)
* Delivered Dose Uniformity and Consistency
* Emitted Dose (shot weight/mass transfer)
* Size Exclusion Chromatography

## Pre-Commercial Services

Services include:
* combination product primary container/dispenser configuration and optimization
* prototype configuration and supply
* analytical testing (devices, primary containers, dispense characteristics)
* process engineering (fill process manufacturing)
* pre-clinical and clinical supply
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation

## Commercial Services

Services include:
* commercial technology transfer
* commercial scale up
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation
* commercial supply
* capital equipment supply and siting
* technology licensing 

[Learn More][28]
[Learn More][29]
[Learn More][30]

## Technology Platforms

Our ZTECH-L™ Delivery Platform is designed to package and deliver liquid drugs, biopharmaceuticals,
biologics and botanicals, while the ZTECH-P™ Delivery Platform is designed for powders or
reconstituted powder to liquid drug/device combination product applications.

[Technology Platforms][31]
[Devices][32]
[Primary Containers][33]

## Biosecurity

Zeteo Biomedical’s ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ drug and biologic delivery platforms provide solutions to
package and administer vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures for infectious diseases
and bio-terror threats.  ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ nasal and sublingual delivery devices are readily
adaptable to public health needs, including rapid manufacturing and deployment to support both self
or caregiver administration options for vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures across
large populations under crisis conditions.

[Learn More][34]

## **Applied Innovation**

Zeteo’s novel drug delivery systems require no priming. We provide consistent, precise dosing and
efficient unit dose packaging to reduce the cost per dose. Devices are available in mono-dose and
multi-dose configurations. The dose counter keeps track of administration, reducing dosing errors
and increasing adherence. The devices are compact, easily carried in a purse or pocket and, with a
small learning curve, enable patient simple self-administration. Our commercially scalable Form Fill
Seal packaging technology supports both non-sterile and aseptic fill processes.

[Learn more][35]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and

big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
